_comment: Claude Code MANAGED settings for cc-isolated (Q-125, decision log 53). Template only:
cc-sandbox-settings.sh fills sandbox.network.allowedDomains from the project's egress
profile and drops _comment, at BUILD time, into /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json
(root-owned 0444). Managed settings outrank user and project settings, so unlike the
settings.json link-claude-home.sh merges, node cannot edit or override this.
enabled + failIfUnavailable: a sandbox that cannot start refuses the session rather
allowUnsandboxedCommands false: dangerouslyDisableSandbox is ignored, so nothing the
model chooses runs outside the sandbox. `!` commands and hooks still run unsandboxed.
autoAllowBashIfSandboxed false: the sandbox is a floor under the permission prompts,
not a replacement for them. Widening prompting is Q-098's decision, not this one.
allowManagedDomainsOnly + strictAllowlist: the firewall admits nothing else, so a
prompt for an unlisted host could only ever fail; deny it instead.
denyRead/denyWrite: the OAuth credential and the files that wire hooks and settings.
allowWrite: the toolchain caches the image points at (cargo, elan, npm, uv, NuGet,
dotnet, gradle), background-job scratch, and /tmp. Everything else under ~ stays
